title: Revisiting the Quantum-Guided Cluster Algorithm: Improvements and Numerical Experiments
summary: We study correlation-guided cluster algorithms for solving the Max-Cut problem that iteratively try to improve solutions by updating clusters of nodes. Building on the recently proposed quantum-guided cluster algorithm (QGCA) [arXiv:2508.10656], which leverages precomputed two-point correlations to guide collective updates, we extend the cluster construction by incorporating next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) information.
